info.title: Banking Management API
info.description: A comprehensive API for managing banking operations, including accounts, transactions, payments, cards, and customer KYC. Adheres to PCI-DSS, PSD2/Open Banking, and KYC/AML compliance standards. All monetary amounts are represented as decimal numbers with explicit currency codes. All API requests are logged for audit purposes, and responses include a `X-Request-ID` for tracing. Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and timeout configurations are detailed in the accompanying API documentation.

tags.name: Accounts
tags.description: Operations related to customer bank accounts.

tags.name: Payments
tags.description: Initiating and managing payments, including Strong Customer Authentication (SCA).

tags.name: Cards
tags.description: Managing customer debit and credit cards.

tags.name: System
tags.description: System-level operations, such as health checks.

get.description: Checks the health and availability of the API. Returns a simple status to indicate if the service is operational.

timestamp.description: The timestamp when the health check was performed.

503.description: Service Unavailable: API is experiencing issues.

get.description: Retrieves a paginated list of all bank accounts associated with the authenticated customer. Includes account details such as balance, type, and status.

200.description: A paginated list of customer accounts.

get.description: Retrieves detailed information for a specific bank account identified by its unique `accountRef`.

get.summary: List transactions for a specific account
get.description: Retrieves a paginated list of transactions associated with a given `accountRef`. Supports filtering by transaction type and date range.

parameters.name: transactionType
parameters.description: Filter transactions by type (e.g., DEBIT, CREDIT, TRANSFER).

parameters.name: startDate
parameters.description: Filter transactions starting from this date (ISO 8601 format).

parameters.name: endDate
parameters.description: Filter transactions up to this date (ISO 8601 format).

200.description: A paginated list of transactions for the specified account.

post.description: Initiates a transfer of funds between two accounts belonging to the same customer. Requires Strong Customer Authentication (SCA) for high-value transfers.

requestBody.description: Transfer details, including destination account and amount.

201.description: Transfer initiated successfully. Awaiting SCA if required.

transactionId.description: Unique identifier for the initiated transfer transaction.

statusCode.description: Current status of the transfer (e.g., PENDING_SCA, IN_PROGRESS, COMPLETED).

post.summary: Initiate a new transaction (e.g., external payment, bill pay)
post.description: Initiates a new financial transaction from a customer's account to an external recipient or for bill payment. Requires Strong Customer Authentication (SCA).

requestBody.description: Details for the transaction to be initiated.

201.description: Transaction initiated successfully. Awaiting SCA if required.

transactionId.description: Unique identifier for the initiated transaction.

statusCode.description: Current status of the transaction (e.g., PENDING_SCA, PENDING, COMPLETED, FAILED).

get.description: Retrieves the current status and full details of a specific transaction using its unique `transactionId`.

post.description: Initiates a new payment from a customer's account. This endpoint is designed for general payments and will typically require Strong Customer Authentication (SCA) based on risk assessment and regulatory requirements.

requestBody.description: Payment details, including source, destination, and amount.

201.description: Payment initiated successfully. May require SCA.

paymentId.description: Unique identifier for the initiated payment.

statusCode.description: Current status of the payment (e.g., PENDING_SCA, PENDING, COMPLETED, FAILED).

get.description: Retrieves a paginated list of all debit and credit cards associated with the authenticated customer. Card numbers are masked for PCI-DSS compliance.

200.description: A paginated list of customer cards.

get.description: Retrieves detailed information for a specific card identified by its unique `cardId`. Card numbers are masked.

post.description: Blocks a customer's card identified by `cardId`. This action is typically irreversible or requires manual intervention to unblock.

statusCode.description: New status of the card (e.g., BLOCKED).

post.description: Unblocks a customer's card identified by `cardId`. This action may require additional verification steps.

requestBody.description: Optional reason for unblocking the card.

reason.description: Optional reason for unblocking the card.

statusCode.description: New status of the card (e.g., ACTIVE).

post.description: Registers a new customer in the banking system. This initiates the KYC/AML process, requiring personal details and potentially identity verification documents.

201.description: Customer created successfully, KYC process initiated.

customerRef.description: Unique identifier for the newly created customer.

get.description: Retrieves detailed information for a specific customer identified by their unique `customerRef`.

patch.description: Updates the Know Your Customer (KYC) status for a specific customer. This endpoint is typically used by internal systems or authorized partners after identity verification.

requestBody.description: New KYC status and optional verification details.

post.summary: Create a new consent for Open Banking
post.description: Establishes a new consent agreement for third-party access to customer account information or payment initiation, as per PSD2/Open Banking regulations. This typically involves customer redirection for authorization.

requestBody.description: Details of the consent request, including requested permissions and expiry.

201.description: Consent request created. Redirect URL provided for customer authorization.

consentId.description: Unique identifier for the created consent.

authorizationUrl.description: URL to redirect the customer for authorization of the consent.

statusCode.description: Current status of the consent (e.g., PENDING_AUTHORIZATION).

value.message: Consent request created. Awaiting customer authorization.

get.description: Retrieves the details and current status of a specific consent agreement.

patch.summary: Update or revoke an existing consent
patch.description: Modifies the status or permissions of an existing consent agreement. This can be used to revoke consent or extend its validity.

requestBody.description: Updates to the consent, such as changing its status to 'REVOKED'.

StandardResponse.description: Standard API response envelope for successful operations.

timestamp.description: The timestamp when the response was generated (ISO 8601).

status.description: Overall status of the API operation.

message.description: A human-readable message providing context for the response.

data.description: The actual response payload, varies by endpoint.

message.description: A human-readable message describing the error.

details.description: Optional array of specific error details, e.g., validation errors.

traceId.description: A unique identifier for the request, useful for tracing issues.

ErrorDetail.description: Detailed information about a specific error, typically for validation issues.

field.description: The field that caused the error.

message.description: A specific message for the field error.

pageSize.description: The number of items per page.

totalCount.description: The total number of items available across all pages.

totalPages.description: The total number of pages available.

hasNextPage.description: Indicates if there is a next page of results.

hasPreviousPage.description: Indicates if there is a previous page of results.

accountNumber.description: The primary account number (masked or full depending on context/permissions).

accountType.description: Type of bank account (e.g., SAVINGS, CHECKING, CREDIT_CARD).

balanceAmount.description: Current available balance of the account. Represented as a decimal number.

currencyCode.description: ISO 4217 currency code for the account balance.

statusCode.description: Current status of the account (e.g., ACTIVE, CLOSED, FROZEN).

accountHolder.description: Name of the primary account holder.

openedDate.description: Date and time when the account was opened (ISO 8601).

accountRef.description: The account from which the transaction originated or was posted to.

totalAmount.description: The amount of the transaction. Positive for credits, negative for debits.

currencyCode.description: ISO 4217 currency code for the transaction amount.

transactionType.description: Type of transaction (e.g., DEBIT, CREDIT, TRANSFER, PAYMENT).

eventTimestamp.description: Date and time when the transaction occurred or was posted (ISO 8601).

description.description: A brief description of the transaction.

merchantName.description: Name of the merchant or recipient for the transaction.

statusCode.description: Current status of the transaction (e.g., COMPLETED, PENDING, FAILED, CANCELLED).

dateOfBirth.description: Customer's date of birth (ISO 8601 date format).

Card.description: Represents a customer's debit or credit card.

accountRef.description: The account this card is linked to.

maskedCardNumber.description: Masked primary account number (PAN) for PCI-DSS compliance (e.g., ************1234).

statusCode.description: Current status of the card (e.g., ACTIVE, BLOCKED, EXPIRED, STOLEN).

cardholderName.description: Name of the cardholder as it appears on the card.

isBlocked.description: Indicates if the card is currently blocked.

TransferFundsRequest.description: Request body for initiating an internal fund transfer.

destinationAccountRef.description: The unique identifier of the destination account for the transfer.

currencyCode.description: ISO 4217 currency code for the transfer amount.

description.description: A brief description or memo for the transfer.

TransactionInitiationRequest.description: Request body for initiating a new transaction (e.g., external payment).

sourceAccountRef.description: The unique identifier of the source account for the transaction.

currencyCode.description: ISO 4217 currency code for the transaction amount.

transactionType.description: The type of transaction to initiate (e.g., PAYMENT, BILL_PAY).

description.description: A brief description or memo for the transaction.

recipientBankCode.description: Recipient's bank identifier (e.g., SWIFT/BIC, ABA routing number).

PaymentInitiationRequest.description: Request body for initiating a new payment.

sourceAccountRef.description: The unique identifier of the source account for the payment.

currencyCode.description: ISO 4217 currency code for the payment amount.

recipientIdentifier.description: Identifier for the recipient (e.g., email, phone number, payment handle).

paymentMethod.description: The method used to identify the recipient for payment.

description.description: A brief description or reference for the payment.

BlockCardRequest.description: Request body for blocking a card.

reason.description: The reason for blocking the card.

notes.description: Additional notes regarding the card block.
notes.example: Customer reported card missing after travel.

CustomerCreationRequest.description: Request body for creating a new customer.

dateOfBirth.description: Customer's date of birth (ISO 8601 date format).

KycVerificationRequest.description: Request body for updating customer KYC status.

kycStatusCode.description: The new KYC status for the customer.

verificationDate.description: Date and time of KYC verification (ISO 8601).

verifiedBy.description: Identifier of the agent or system that performed the verification.

rejectionReason.description: Reason for KYC rejection, if applicable.

Consent.description: Represents a customer's consent for Open Banking access.

consentId.description: Unique identifier for the consent agreement.

customerRef.description: The customer who granted the consent.

thirdPartyId.description: Identifier of the Third-Party Provider (TPP) to whom consent is granted.

permissions.description: List of permissions granted (e.g., accounts:read, transactions:read).

statusCode.description: Current status of the consent (e.g., PENDING_AUTHORIZATION, AUTHORIZED, REVOKED, EXPIRED).

createdAt.description: Date and time when the consent was created (ISO 8601).

authorizedAt.description: Date and time when the consent was authorized by the customer (ISO 8601). Null if not yet authorized.

expiryDate.description: Date and time when the consent will expire (ISO 8601).

ConsentCreationRequest.description: Request body for creating a new consent.

customerRef.description: The customer who is granting the consent.

thirdPartyId.description: Identifier of the Third-Party Provider (TPP) requesting consent.

permissions.description: List of permissions requested by the TPP (e.g., accounts:read, transactions:read).

expiryDate.description: Optional date and time when the consent should expire (ISO 8601). If not provided, default expiry will be applied.

redirectUri.description: The URI to which the customer will be redirected after authorization.

ConsentUpdateRequest.description: Request body for updating an existing consent.

statusCode.description: The new status for the consent (e.g., REVOKED).

revocationReason.description: Optional reason for revoking the consent.

ConsentIdParam.name: consentId
ConsentIdParam.description: Unique identifier for the consent agreement.

XRequestID.name: X-Request-ID
XRequestID.description: A unique identifier for the request, useful for tracing and debugging across services. If not provided, the server will generate one.

IdempotencyKeyHeader.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKeyHeader.description: A unique key that the client provides to prevent duplicate requests. If a request with the same key is received, the server will return the same response as the original request without re-processing it.

RateLimitLimit.description: The maximum number of requests that the client can make in the current rate limit window.

RateLimitRemaining.description: The number of requests remaining in the current rate limit window.

X-RateLimit-Reset.description: The time at which the current rate limit window resets in UTC epoch seconds.

XRequestIDResponse.description: A unique identifier for the request, echoed back from the client or generated by the server, useful for tracing and debugging across services.

BadRequest.description: Bad Request: The request was malformed or invalid.

error.message: Invalid input provided. Check 'details' for specific errors.

details.message: Amount must be greater than zero.

Unauthorized.description: Unauthorized: Authentication is required or has failed.

error.message: Authentication token is missing or invalid.

Forbidden.description: Forbidden: The client does not have sufficient permissions to access the resource.

NotFound.description: Not Found: The requested resource could not be found.

Conflict.description: Conflict: The request could not be completed due to a conflict with the current state of the resource (e.g., duplicate entry, idempotency key mismatch).

error.message: Idempotency key already used with a different request payload.

InternalServerError.description: Internal Server Error: An unexpected error occurred on the server.

error.message: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again later.
